Name: Social Stream Ninja
Description: Control Social Stream Ninja from Stream Deck keys and dials.

ninja.socialstream.streamdeck.connection.Name: Setup
ninja.socialstream.streamdeck.connection.Tooltip: Enter the Social Stream Ninja session ID and test the plugin connection.

ninja.socialstream.streamdeck.command.Name: Preset Command
ninja.socialstream.streamdeck.command.Tooltip: Send a common Social Stream Ninja remote-control command.

ninja.socialstream.streamdeck.custom-com.Name: Custom Command
ninja.socialstream.streamdeck.custom-com.Tooltip: Send any Social Stream Ninja API command for advanced workflows.

ninja.socialstream.streamdeck.timer-dial.Name: Timer Dial
ninja.socialstream.streamdeck.timer-dial.Tooltip: Adjust and monitor the Social Stream Ninja timer from a dial.

ninja.socialstream.streamdeck.chat-feed.Name: Chat Review
ninja.socialstream.streamdeck.chat-feed.Tooltip: Review recent chat, pin a message, and feature the next pinned message.

Localization.pi.status.enterSession: Enter a Social Stream Ninja session ID.
Localization.pi.status.sessionHelp: Desktop app: open Stream Deck Setup. Chrome extension: open Settings and copy your unique session ID.
Localization.pi.setup.sessionPlaceholder: Paste session ID or dock.html?session=... URL
Localization.pi.setup.sessionHint: Copy your session ID from Stream Deck Setup in the desktop app or Settings in the Chrome extension. Full dock/overlay URLs also work.
Localization.pi.setup.channelHint: Default Stream Deck remote control sends on channel 1 and listens for callbacks on channel 2.
Localization.pi.setup.quickStart: Desktop app: Stream Deck Setup. Chrome extension: Settings. Copy the session ID, paste it here, and test once.
Localization.pi.capabilities.unavailable: Desktop app source controls are unavailable until capabilities are received.
Localization.pi.capabilities.pending: Desktop app source controls will appear here after Social Stream Ninja advertises them.
Localization.pi.preset.heading: Preset Command
Localization.pi.preset.hint: Preset commands use the documented Social Stream Ninja remote-control API.
Localization.pi.preset.sourceHint: Select one open desktop app source to reply there only. The source is resolved again when the key is pressed, so restarts are safe.
Localization.pi.preset.desktopHint: Desktop app commands are still sent through Social Stream Ninja, which decides how to route them.
Localization.pi.preset.waitHint: This command waits for the result.
Localization.pi.preset.confirmHint: Standalone keys require two presses; Multi Actions reset immediately.
Localization.pi.custom.heading: Custom Command
Localization.pi.custom.hint: Custom Command is for payloads not yet exposed as presets.
Localization.pi.timer.heading: Timer Dial
Localization.pi.timer.hint: Turn to adjust. Press to start or pause. Hold the touch strip to reset.
Localization.pi.chat.heading: Chat Review
Localization.pi.chat.hint: Turn to browse recent chat, press to pin, tap to feature the next pinned message, or hold to unpin. In Social Stream Ninja, enable “Send chat messages to API server”.
Localization.pi.status.connecting: Connecting to the Social Stream Ninja API.
Localization.pi.status.apiError: The Social Stream Ninja API connection reported an error.
Localization.pi.status.readyNote: Ready. Only controls supported by this runtime are shown.
Localization.pi.status.sessionNote: Copy the session ID from the Social Stream Ninja desktop app or Chrome extension, then keep it running.
Localization.deviceChatEnableRelay: Enable “Send chat messages to API server” in Social Stream Ninja.
